name: labs/josuablejeru__labmastro
title: Hanmatek HM bench supply (labmastro Modbus RTU)
intro: Hanmatek HM bench supply (labmastro Modbus RTU), adapted from josuablejeru/labmastro. It reads `output_enabled`, `voltage` and `current`; sets `voltage_setpoint`, `current_setpoint`, `over_voltage_protection` and `over_current_protection`; runs `output_on` and `output_off`. `output_on`: enable the output (0x0001 = 1, confirmed by read-back) at the supply's live setpoints, which this package cannot read or bound: set and verify them on the supply first. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
